featured.title: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly
featured.tldr: When long-running coding agents summarize their context to keep going, benchmark scores barely change, but the rules they were given quietly disappear from the summaries.

featured.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
featured.tldr: Remory adds a bounded set of learned soft tokens after a text summary so a frozen agent keeps more of its history after context compaction, improving agent benchmarks and cutting tool errors.
